history.body: Hello, I’m interested in the project from your ad. Is it suitable for a young couple buying our first home?

It could be a good one to consider. The Phase 1 homes are 900 sq.ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, giving you room to keep a bedroom for yourselves and use the other rooms as your needs evolve. I’d recommend viewing together so you can see whether the layout feels right for your first home.
That makes sense, especially having the space for later. We’re still comparing places though. Is it convenient for shops and daily errands around there?

Yes—Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and the wider Butterworth/mainland network. That gives you established destinations to consider for shopping and everyday errands, rather than relying entirely on future township development. I wouldn’t guess exact walking or driving times, but when you visit you can judge the routes against your usual routine as well as see how the layout feels for you both.
That’s helpful to know. We usually drive for errands, so being near established places sounds convenient. I’d still want to check the route from where we work before deciding about a visit.

That’s a sensible check before deciding about a visit. Since you usually drive, compare the route from work to Seberang Jaya at your usual travel time; the established places for errands are a plus, but your commute matters too. If the route looks workable, visiting together would let you judge the approach and see whether the 900 sq.ft. layout feels right for you both.
